contribuer.subtitle: This wiki is written on two sources held in its own right: the {tomes} volumes of the manga and the transcribed plates from the databooks. It is far from finished — and it has no reason to be finished by one person.

steps.editTitle: Open the form and click on “Suggest a correction”
steps.editText: The button is under the title of each sheet, and under each section. The current text opens in an editing area: you modify what is wrong, nothing else.
steps.sourceTitle: Indicates where the information comes from
steps.sourceText: A volume and a plate, a databook and a page. A sourced correction is proofread in a few minutes; without a source, you have to check it first, which takes days.
steps.reviewTitle: A reviewer publishes — under your name
steps.reviewText: Nothing is changed until a proposal is accepted. Once published, the modification appears in the wiki history with your nickname, and remains undoable.

contribuer.acceptedMangaText: — the volume and plate number (“volume 17, plate 42”).
contribuer.acceptedDatabooksText: — Daizenshuu, Chōzenshū, official guides, with the page.
contribuer.acceptedAnimeText: , provided that it is said: what is not in the manga is marked as such.
contribuer.refusedWikisText: , Fandom in the lead. The content that comes from it is being replaced here; recopying it would bring back what was removed.
contribuer.refusedGamesText: presented as canon - many files still bear the wording, this is precisely what is being corrected.
contribuer.refusedGuessText: — “probably”, “without doubt”. Better to write nothing than to write something plausible.
contribuer.gapsNone: All visible cards have at least one text. All that remains is to check them and explore them further: open any file and compare it to your source.
contribuer.gapsCount: {count} visible records have neither article nor description. Counted at the moment, directly in base.
contribuer.contributorsNone: No one has a published contribution yet. The first accepted correction will appear here — and in the history of the record concerned.
contribuer.waysFixText: You offer the exact value, with your source. A moderator sees the diff and applies: the revision is recorded in YOUR name.
contribuer.waysTalkText: Each card and each article has a thread. This is where we resolve an inconsistency before touching the text.
contribuer.waysTranscribeText: Databooks are scanned; their pages are waiting to be read, transcribed and translated.
contribuer.footnote: A question, a doubt about a source? The “Report an error” button at the bottom of each page goes through the same channel.

download.title: Download Shenron Studio
download.subtitle: The desktop app for Windows: Shenron and its Dragon Ball model, on your computer.

help.title: Install in three steps
help.step1: Open the downloaded file. Installation needs no administrator rights.
help.step2: Start Shenron Studio from the Start menu or the desktop shortcut.
help.step3: On first launch, let the app download its models (about 6 GB).
